description: The inner fetch_url function is separated from fetch_mta_sts_policy_body so tests can call it with an http:// URL pointing at a local axum mock server. This is the correct approach: it keeps the domain-validation and URL-construction logic testable without requiring a real TLS certificate, while the security invariants (no redirects, WebPKI roots) are enforced by the reqwest::Client built in production, not in the inner function.
title: smtp: mta_sts_fetcher.rs separates fetch_url for testability without real TLS
